svg.title: Chromosome 4 and 12 gamete associations, source slide 48
svg.desc: Original ODP native chromosome rows restored with shared vector chromosome components. One complete frozen gamete reference remains at upper right. Columns preserve adjacent-1, adjacent-2, and alternate product associations; source labels stay live.

svg.title: Reciprocal-translocation gamete products
svg.desc: Three columns of four gametes, each with two unreplicated chromosomes. Source red and blue ancestry segments and the distinct final two normal chromosome orders are preserved.

g.text: All gametes from adjacent-1 and adjacent-2
